::: {#rem-perplexity-source}
#### Source of the name

The name comes from speech recognition [@jelinek1977perplexity].
Leinster defines the "diversity of order 1"
as the [exponential](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-exponential-function)
of the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy)
[@leinster2021entropy, Definition 2.4.1].
He calls a diversity index an "effective number"
when it is $k$ for $k$ species with the same abundance [@leinster2021entropy, Definition 2.4.5].

:::
